QuestInfo.name: Food-Hunting for Moppie III
QuestInfo.0: Moppie's master, Huckle, wants to ask me for another favor...now what?
QuestInfo.1: Huckle's time is still consumed by his studies, and he wants you to get even more fish for Moppie. This time, he wants 150 of them! Deliver them to Moppie. \n\n#i4000088##t4000088# #b#c4000088#/150#k
QuestInfo.2: You gathered 150 of Jr. Pepe's fish and delivered them to Moppie, but...

0.0: Aren't you the one that wanted to be my assistant? Did Moppie like the fishes? Did you tell him I sent for it? ...Really? Moppie liked them that much??
0.1: Alright! Moppie should be fed more with stuff he likes. Can you gather up 150 this time? I may hire you as my assistant if this goes well.

yes.0: Thank you! I may even put your name in one of the studies I conduct in the future. Make sure to pick up the fish that the Jr. Pepes drop at the bottom of Orbis Tower. 150 types of fish for Moppie! \n\n#i4000088# #t4000088# #b150#k

no.0: Right now... I am so busy with this work that I can't do anything else in my life.

1.0: Fish again? Did my master send for it again? I just wish he stops working so hard on his research... bark, I understand that he wants to take care of me, but ...

yes.0: Yuck, that smell of fish. My master may not like to hear what I'm about to say, but... I'm sick of it! Bark! Please don't bring fish again, bark... please... bark bark!
yes.1: Anyway, thanks for the great news, bark! You really do love all animals, bark!

item.0: Hey, is that all the fishes you have?
